title: Instrument
description: One tradable market on one venue, with its price/quantity grid. THE ONLY NEAR-COMPLETE CANONICAL ENTITY IN THE REPO: the type and the id convention exist (backend/api/internal/markets/instruments/instrument.go Instrument, InstrumentID = 'exchange:market_type:BASE/QUOTE', evidenced by the fixture in instrument_test.go), the symbol normalization exists (symbol.go CanonicalSymbol/VenueSymbol) and the grid rounding exists (rounding.go RoundQuantityDown/RoundPrice). NO PRODUCER MINTS IT outside tests, and no service serves it over HTTP. Closed object: the field set is the Go struct's, and additionalProperties is false because Validate refuses unknown grid parameters rather than ignoring them. Absent-vs-zero rule (instrument.go doc): an empty grid string or null means 'the venue did not report it', never 0 - ContractSize excepted, which must be positive ('a zero would silently zero out every notional').

instrument_id.description: Canonical id. Convention today: 'exchange:market_type:BASE/QUOTE' (src fixture 'binance:spot:BTC/USDT'). Consumers MUST treat it as opaque.

base_asset.description: Reference-by-id form of the Go struct's bare symbol string.

exchange.description: Venue name as spelled in code ('binance'), lowercase by convention.

exchange_symbol.description: The symbol EXACTLY as the venue spells it ('BTCUSDT'); never the canonical form.

min_quantity.description: Null when the venue does not report it (the Go empty string).

contract_size.description: Contract multiplier applied to quantity to get notional; '1' for spot. MUST be positive.

price_precision.description: Decimal places the venue prints for prices; 0 is legal.

max_leverage.description: Venue leverage ceiling; the Go int field, 1 = no leverage.

market_type.description: Frozen pair, declared identically in backend/api/internal/markets/instruments/instrument.go and backend/api/internal/accounts/exchange/account.go (duplicated type, same values - see canonical-model.md D-US2). The executor's TS union is the same two values (frontend/web/src/platform/executor/types.ts MarketType).
